senses.en_definition: To experience or undergo an event, change, or difficulty.

messages.en: Maybe the system's acting up again. I've tried three times and still can't get in.
Same here. Hang on, let me check with IT first. I'll let you know when they get back to me.

senses.en_definition: To pick up, take hold of, or carry something away.
To take or use something belonging to someone else, with or without permission.
To require or use an amount of time or space.
To obtain a measurement or reading.
To recruit or accept someone for employment or study.
To go somewhere to collect a person or thing.

collocations.en: pick up one's child from school

senses.en_definition: To make a decision or take action, in fixed expressions.

messages.en: I want to come over to your place to pick up some stuff this evening. Is six okay?
Sure, I'll be home then. Text me when you're close, okay?
Your parcel's arrived at the office. I just picked it up for you.
Thanks! Just leave it on my desk. I'll open it later.

collocations.en: assume that everything has been taken care of

messages.en: Amir still hasn't replied to my message. I'm starting to think he's mad at me.
Don't go assuming he's mad at you. He's just got home from work and wants to rest.
